translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: HECHOS
book.title: An t’ajbilab ax in t’ajamal an abathualechic

content: ―Pay’lomlabchic ani at juntalabchic, tiquin ats’anchi jahua’ ne’ets tu olchi tin cuenta a jolbixtalchic.
Tam ti an mulcunel in ats’a’ u taunab tin cuete’ cahuintal hebreo, tam lej piclelen quin ats’a’chic. A Pablo in ucha’chic tam:

―Nana’its in Israel. In hua’tsin ti bichou Tarso axi cuentalith ti Cilicia, ani in yejthame teje’ ti bichou Jerusalén. A Gamaliel jats tin tala’ exobchi an ts’ejcath cau axi pithnenec i biyal juntalchic. Ets’ey u lubamal cu lej putu c’al an ts’ejcath cau c’al patal u ichich, jant’ini’ tata’chicte xo’ a lubal ca putu.
Tam ti jayq’ui’ u lej othnamal axi belomchic c’al an alhua’ cau. U ne’thamal i inic ani i uxumchic abal ca baliyat al an huic’axte’. Ma talchic u binamal ca tsemtha.

An oc’lec pale’chic ani an yejtselabchic ax u eyal in ejtohual ti olchichic jant’ini’ tim pithnenec i thuchath u cu ne’tha’ c’al u at Israel ti Damasco. Tats tin c’ale cu alimichiquiy am belomchic, expith abal cu chi’tha’ teje’ ti Jerusalén cu bina’ abal ca yajchiquiyat.
A Pablo in olnal jant’ini’ ti huenc’on c’al a Dios
Ts’ejel q’uicha tam tin ne’ets tihua’ ti bel utatits ti Damasco, jun jic’tohual ijcan jun i tajax jun tin ne’ets. Pel i tajax ley ts’umimil tal ti eb.
Tam in ijcan tsabal. U ats’a’ in taunab: ¿Tata’ ojni’ Saulo, jale’ hualam tin othnachiquiyal?
Tam u conoy: ¿Jita’ tata’, Ajatic? Ani jaja’ tin toc’tsiy: Nana’its in Jesús Nazaretib ax tin othnachiquiyal.
U junquilchic yab in ats’a’ an cau jahua’ nan in uchan, tocat in tsu’uchic an tajax ani lej jiq’uey.
Tam nan u conoy ax tin tauna’: ¿Ajatic, jant’ini’ hualam a le’ nan cu t’aja’ xo’? Jaja’ tin ucha’: Quit ts’aquiy ani quit c’ale ti Damasco. Taja’ hua’ats jita’ ne’ets ti olchi jant’ini’ ta ca t’aja’.
Cum in joc’tsibethach c’al an tajax, in ne’tha lotocomte c’al u junquilchic ma ti Damasco.
Ti Damasco c’uajat jun i inic im bij Ananias ax in lej putuhual c’al an ts’ejcath cau binath c’al a Moisés. U uxnal ti lej alhua’ inic c’al patal an Israelchic taja’.
Chich jaja’ tiquin tsu’u. Tin ucha’: Ebchal Saulo, ma xo’ ne’ets quit tsu’xin junil. Tameq’ui tam u ejtohualits tin t’ajat tsu’ux.

Tam a Ananias tin uchaye: In Diosil i biyal juntalchic jats ax ti tacuyamalits ma ti biyalits abal ca exlanchi jaja’ in culbetal. Jaye abal ca tsu’chi in lej tsu’uxtal hual a Jesús axi pel in t’ocat Tsacamil a Dios ani ca lej tejhua’ tsu’ux hual ats’anchi in cahuintal.
Jaxtam ne’ets ca olnanchi im bij a Jesús c’al patal an inicchic. Ne’ets ca olchichic jahua’ a tsu’umal ani jahua’ a ats’amal tin cuenta a Jesús.
Cum yabats a yejenchal ca aychiye más i cau, expith quit c’ale ani quit pujan. Ca conchi an Ajatic abal ti t’oquethanchi a hualab ta ichich. Antsana’ tin ucha’ a Ananías, in ulal a Pablo.
A Pablo in olnal jant’ini’ ti aban c’al a Dios ca c’ale c’al axi yab Israelchic
Tam tin huichits ti Jerusalén, in c’ale ti tiyopan quin olon. Taja’ in tsu’binchame ejtil i huachbilab.
U tsu’u an Ajatic ani u ats’a’ tin ucha’: Ca tsemanchi quit tixc’an ti Jerusalén, cum an inicchic taja’ yab ne’ets quin le’na’ ti belchi jahua’ ca olchi tin cuenta u bij.

Tam nan u ucha’ an Ajatic: Ajatic, jaja’chic in tso’obits jahua’ u t’ajamalits ti jayq’ui’ abal ju’tamits tin xe’tsinenec in otsits tin tiyopanil an Israel cu caltha’ axi belomchic c’al tata’ a bij. U mo’canchamal i c’ubaclec ani u binamal ca baliyatchic ti al an huic’axte’.

Tam ti huac’lanchatits in xits’al a Esteban, tam nan in cubatq’ui utat. Ani a Esteban pel a lej t’ojnalil ax ti olnanchamal a bij. Ani u tsalpay abal lej alhua’ jahua’ antsana’ in t’ajal an tsemthomchic. Ma nan u beletnanchi in toltomilchic.
Ani taley an Ajatic tin ucha’: Quit c’alets, cum ne’ets tu abaye ou c’al axi yab Israel ca olchichic an alhua’ cau.
T’ilom a Pablo c’al an comandante
Expith ja in le’na’ quin ats’anchi an mulcunel in cahuintal a Pablo. Tam in thajat uluchic: ―Ca tsemtha’ nixe’ xi inic. Yabats in tomnal ca xe’tsin ejat.
Exome ti thajajal an mulcunel. Ma c’al in tsacultal tocat in huac’lachiquiyal in toltomil al an ic’ ani im pet’nachiquiyal i pojoth al an ic’.

Tam an comandante in ucha’ an soldadochic quin otha’ a Pablo tin atajil. Jaye in ucha’chic quin huipiy abal quin olna’ an jolbixtalab ax u t’ajchinal c’al an mulcunel. Ca tso’obna jale’ ti lej thajajalchic an mulcunel tin cuenta a Pablo.

Tam ti huic’anits abal ca huipiyat, tam a Pablo in ucha’ an capitán: ―Yab a uchbil tiquin huipiy, cum pel tin lej aticlab cuentalith Roma, ani jaye yabaye in ts’ejcanchame an cau c’al an ts’ejcom cau abal ca tejhua’me max pel a uchbil tiquin huipiy.

Tam tin ats’a’its antsana’ an cau an capitán jahua’ in ulu a Pablo, c’ale quin olchi an comandante. In ucha’: ―Ca lej t’aja’ ti cuenta jahua’ a t’ajchal nixe’ xi inic cum pel i aticlab cuentalith Roma.
Tam utey an comandante c’al a Pablo quin conoy: ―¿Chubaxcua’ tata’ it aticlab cuentalith Roma? Toc’tsin a Pablo: ―Ojni’ chubax ja’its nana’.
Tam uchan a Pablo c’al an comandante: ―Nana’ u pacu yan i tumin abal cu baju tin aticlab cuentalith Roma. Tam a Pablo in ucha’: ―Nana’ pelits tu hua’tsintal tin aticlab cuentalith Roma.

Tam tixc’an an soldadochic axi ne’etsac quin huipiy a Pablo. Ma jiq’uey jaye an comandante, cum olchin abal a Pablo pel i lej aticlab cuentalith Roma. Ani tin ebal jaja’ in cahuintal jats ti huic’ath a Pablo.
A Pablo tin tamet an cuenel ts’ejcom cau axi lej c’athpich exbath in ey c’al an Israelchic

Ma tin aytal q’uicha tam ti tixc’anchatits a Pablo an calaniyo pat’al. An comandante in aba’ an cau ca tamcun an oc’lec pale’chic ani an cuenel ts’ejcom cau axi lej c’athpich exbath in ey c’al an Israelchic. In le’ quin tequeth exlanchi an jolbixtalab ax u t’ajchinal a Pablo c’al jaja’chic. Tam ne’tha a Pablo tin tamet an jolbixchic.
